title: System information and control data
desc: The radio HU shall allow a user to see system information, download and restore data, and take a screen snapshot.

title: System information and control data - 01
desc: The radio HU shall allow a user to see system information

title: System information and control data - 02
desc: The radio HU shall allow a user to download data.

title: System information and control data - 03
desc: The radio HU shall allow a user to restore data.

title: System information and control data - 04
desc: The radio HU shall allow a user to take a screen snapshot.

title: Access for Issue Resolution and Customer Support
desc: The dealer mode will be used by Stellantis dealerships and other outside groups to assist the customer in resolving issues.

title: English-Only Dealer Mode Screens
desc: The screens developed for dealer mode are not required to implement languages other than English.

title: Entering Dealer Mode
desc: When the HU enters dealer mode, the HU shall display the main menu.  Do not store and recall the last entry displayed before exiting.

title: Normal Operation with Information Gathering
desc: When the HU enters dealer mode, the HU shall continue to operate in normal mode by implementing each system with the exception that the display shows the dealer mode menu and the HU enters the process

title: Exiting Dealer Mode
desc: If Dealer Mode has an "X" button, the HU shall exit through the "X" button instead.

title: Exit Navigation
desc: For each screen, the display shall have a method, virtual button, to exit the screen and return to the last location in the dealer mode menu.

title: Copy User Data to SD/USB
desc: The display shall allow the user to select to download user data from flash memory to either the USB storage device or the SD card, if so equipped.

title: Stored User Media and EQ Settings
desc:
The following information shall be stored:
 Media Presets
 SXM Favorites
 Driver User EQ Settings

desc: The display shall allow the user to select to download user data from either the USB mass storage device or the SD card, if so equipped, to flash memory.

desc: The display shall allow the user to select to download user data from either the USB mass storage device or the SD card, if so equipped, to flash memory.

title: Screenshot Mode
desc: For the steps to perform the Screenshot for R1L, refer to reference document "Screenshot and System Level Logs function".

title: Screenshot Timing
desc: The screenshot shall be taken within the time listed in reference document "Screenshot and System Level Logs function".

title: Write Storage Timing
desc: The write process to the storage media shall start within 2 seconds, and finish within 10 seconds.

title: Write Storage Timing - 01
desc: The write process to the storage media shall start within 2 seconds.

title: Write Storage Timing - 02
desc: The write process to the storage media shall finish within 10 seconds.

title: Screenshot file format
desc: The screenshot file shall be saved in a commonly used format (e.g. BMP, JPEG, PNG).

title: Screenshot file name
desc: The filename of the screenshot shall contain the date and time when the screenshot was taken (e.g. "yyyymmddhhmmss.bmp").

title: Showroom Demo Mode
desc: The Showroom Demo Mode shall be able to be turned ON and OFF from the Dealer Mode.

title: Upload Demo Video
desc: The user shall upload the Showroom Demo Video from USB device through the File Browser interface.

title: Maximum File Size in HU
desc: The maximum memory size for a single file shall be 200MB.

title: Play Video
desc: The HU shall load and play the Demo Video.

title: Functionality of Personal Data Clearing
desc: Clear personal data shall remove the Demo Video and disable the functionality in the Dealer Mode.

title: Functionality of Personal Data Clearing - 01
desc: Clear personal data shall remove the Demo Video in the Dealer Mode.

title: Functionality of Personal Data Clearing - 02
desc: Clear personal data shall disable the functionality in the Dealer Mode.

desc: The Dealer Mode shall have the option to not allow user to exit the Video.  If set, once video starts, the video only exits when video finishes playing and returns to last HU screen, or video continue

title: Showroom Demo Video Lock Option - 01
desc: The Dealer Mode shall have the option to not allow user to exit the Video.  If set, once video starts, the video only exits when video finishes playing and returns to last HU screen, the user has to u

title: Showroom Demo Video Lock Option - 02
desc: The Dealer Mode shall have the option to not allow user to exit the Video.  If set, once video starts, the video continues to loop play if set to repeat, the user has to use Dealer Mode then to exit.

title: Showroom Demo Video Format Restriction
desc: Dealer Mode shall only allow video file types to be uploaded.  Reference CFTS018 for the allowed video file types.

title: Showroom Demo Playback Reset
desc: Dealer Demo shall not play over ignition cycles.
